composition_summary: Reviewed the volatile tail and preserved it exactly. The request is a pure-logic class-22 draft (pc-check-channel-list) that validates a raw channel list and returns an advisory ok/empty result — no Tool dispatch, no reply, no effect. The host sink supports class 22 (name/description/content) and drops class 21, so no recipe_update is proposed. The draft is an unapproved target-interface candidate: it does not claim runtime support for the inputs mapping, and it does not relax required-input binding for ordinary Tool usages. The body uses inputs.get for the raw candidate so absence is a valid outcome, validates every element's exact integer type (bool is not an int) and range 0..255 before deciding, and returns the requested invalid-result object (ok=false, channels=[]) for malformed data rather than raising. It assigns result on every branch and contains only declared fields. No UUIDs, versions or approval were invented; activation requires Q1, human Q2 and behavioral validation.

payload.name: pc-check-channel-list
payload.description: Pure-logic validator for a raw channel list. Accepts a list (including an empty list) whose items are exact integers 0..255 inclusive; rejects bool, float, null, missing and wrong types. Returns an advisory object only; it performs no Tool dispatch, reply or effect. Unapproved target-interface draft; the inputs mapping and Monty execution are runtime prerequisites, not established support.

adjusted_volatile_messages: Validate a channel list; no channels is a valid choice.
